hardQuoteObservations.preregisteredQuote: Luxury All-You-Can-Drink Course Enjoying the Specialty Unagi Hitsumabushi JPY 8,800 [6 Dishes] Available for Same-Day Reservations for 2 or More People

Indulge in our luxurious all-you-can-drink course featuring our signature "Oke Hitsumabushi" (grilled eel served over rice in a wooden tub). Start with an assorted platter of seasonal appetizers, followed by fragrant grilled edamame with sansho pepper, fluffy rolled eel omelet, and perfectly grilled yakitori, each dish crafted with care. For the main course, savor the rich flavors of our "Oke Hitsumabushi." To finish off, enjoy a refreshing ice cream wrapped in a monaka wafer, allowing you to relish the lingering taste. Additionally, this course includes an all-you-can-drink option featuring premium sake from across Japan, as well as our unique "tea with shochu". Delight in drinks that pair perfectly with eel, such as sansho ale, hojicha with shochu, and matcha with banana shochu.
